name: Ig2_PP_PP_ScGeom
description: EXPERIMENTAL. IGeom functor for PotentialParticle - PotentialParticle pair

attributes.name: accuracyTol
attributes.description: accuracy desired, tolerance criteria for SOCP

attributes.name: calContactArea
attributes.description: Whether to calculate jointLength for 2-D contacts and contactArea for 2-D and 3-D contacts

attributes.name: areaStep
attributes.description: Angular step (degrees) to calculate KnKsPhys.contactArea. Must be a divisor of 360, e.g. 1,2,3,4,5,6,8,9 and so on, to form a closed loop. Must be smaller than 90 degrees. Smaller angles lead to more accurate calculations but are more expensive

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be a valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Dispatcher itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled==True.

attributes.name: bases
attributes.description: Ordered list of types (as strings) this functor accepts.
